obligations.source_text: Create an independent reference-guided photographic stress test in which the selected random complex concept makes the ample body, broad sleeves, layered structure, and embroidered neckline of a West African grand boubou visibly judgeable.

bindings.broad_sleeve_phrase: both broad sleeve openings remain visible
bindings.center_axis_phrase: dense embroidery frames the neckline and center front
bindings.inner_layer_phrase: a coordinated inner wrapper remains visible beneath the outer robe
bindings.volume_legibility_phrase: the continuous shoulder-to-body volume remains legible
